artifacts.summary: Six-phase, four-wave plan reframing nine core source-store surfaces for the ignored-specs posture, placing task 661's durability statement verbatim, with eager-context-budget and index-entries.json line_count gate collisions planned for explicitly.

memory_candidates.content: In this codebase, any phase editing a file under a core extension's context/** tree must declare that extension's index-entries.json in the same phase's Files to modify and run generate-context-line-counts.sh --write there: check-extension-docs.sh Rule R fails on line_count drift, and verify-deploy.sh Gate 3 aggregates that doc-lint, so the drift is commit-blocking. Paths under rules/**, docs/**, and commands/** carry no indexed row and so have no such coupling -- index-entries.json paths are stored relative to context/, which is why a naive grep for the full source-store-relative path finds zero rows and can mislead a planner into thinking no coupling exists.
